STEP 6 - Grams: Cauliflower 400 ml x 0.55 g/ml (cut vegetable) ≈ 220 g. Oil ≈ 2 g.

STEP 7 - Energy: Cooked cauliflower ≈ 23 kcal/100 g → 220 g × 0.23 = ~51 kcal. Oil/butter ≈ 884 kcal/100 g → 2 g × 8.84 ≈ 18 kcal (for a light coating, possibly more, but kept small).

STEP 8 - Sanity check: A visible pile of cauliflower covering roughly a third of a plate at about 220 g is plausible for a side portion. Total ~222 g and ~69 kcal fits what is visible.
